description: Single source of truth for environment variables. Consumed by (1) per-package zod env schemas that validate at boot, (2) scripts/bootstrap-env.mjs which generates .env.local files, and (3) the Repobot platform when provisioning environments. Classes: config = committed non-secret, public = per-project client-safe value, secret = server-only, never committed, never VITE_-prefixed.

vars.name: DATABASE_URL
vars.description: Postgres connection string for the environment's database.

vars.name: AUTH_MODE
vars.description: 'local' (emulator-only dev principal tokens) or 'builtin' (the kernel's own auth service). Deployed boot refuses 'local'.

vars.name: LOCAL_AUTH_SECRET
vars.description: HS256 secret for locally issued dev tokens. Generated per checkout by bootstrap:env; never used in deployed environments.

vars.name: AUTH_JWT_SECRET
vars.description: HS256 secret (hex) that signs and verifies built-in auth JWTs. Generated per environment by the platform when the deploy manifest declares the AUTH capability.

vars.name: AUTH_PUBLIC_URL
vars.description: Public URL of the auth__request__api function; used for OAuth callbacks and the magic-link fallback URLs in auth emails.

vars.name: AUTH_OAUTH_PROXY_URL
vars.description: Platform OAuth callback proxy base URL. When set, OAuth sign-in uses it as the provider redirect_uri (the one stable URL customers whitelist) and the proxy forwards callbacks to this environment. Empty = providers redirect straight to AUTH_PUBLIC_URL.

vars.name: APP_BASE_URL
vars.description: The environment's live site URL ({{ .SiteURL }} in auth emails, OAuth redirect allowlist). Tracks the custom domain when one is active.

vars.name: SITE_BASE_URL
vars.description: Canonical public host for the SEO generator (scripts/generate-seo-files.mjs): absolute sitemap <loc> URLs and the robots.txt Sitemap line. Unset = root-relative sitemap output (docs/seo.md).

vars.name: SMTP_HOST
vars.description: SMTP host for all outgoing email (auth emails and the mail kernel's transactional sends). Empty = degraded mode: signups auto-confirm, OTP/recovery emails are unavailable, and mail-kernel sends log instead of delivering.

vars.name: SMTP_PORT
vars.description: SMTP port (587 STARTTLS or 465 TLS).

vars.name: SMTP_USER
vars.description: SMTP account username.

vars.name: SMTP_PASS
vars.description: SMTP account password / API key.

vars.name: SMTP_SENDER_EMAIL
vars.description: From address for all outgoing email (auth + mail kernel). Switches to the owner's verified sender domain — managed on the platform dashboard's Domains page — when one is active (docs/mail.md).

vars.name: SMTP_SENDER_NAME
vars.description: Display name for the From header of all outgoing email (auth + mail kernel).

vars.name: MAIL_DAILY_QUOTA
vars.description: Daily cap on outgoing email over the shared platform SMTP account, counted per UTC calendar day across template and auth mail together. Empty or '0' = the kernel default of 200/day; a negative value = unlimited (for projects on their own verified sender domain). Auth emails (sign-in codes, recovery) stay deliverable up to 2x the cap so a template-mail flood cannot lock users out of sign-in; beyond-quota template sends degrade to a log line (docs/mail.md).

vars.name: AUTH_EMAIL_TEMPLATES
vars.description: Auth email template overrides (repobot.emails.json contract, layered with dashboard overrides by the platform) as JSON or base64-encoded JSON. Empty = kernel defaults.

vars.name: AUTH_DEV_CODE
vars.description: Dev-only fixed sign-in code: when set on a dev-posture deploy, the email-code verify step also accepts this value for any address, so operators can sign in test users without email delivery. Unset by default (the bypass is unreachable then); production boot refuses it.

vars.name: GOOGLE_SIGNIN_CLIENT_ID
vars.description: Google OAuth client id for the 'google' sign-in method. Injected from the account's Google Sign-In integration; empty when not connected.

vars.name: GOOGLE_SIGNIN_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.description: Google OAuth client secret for the server-side code exchange.

vars.name: APPLE_SIGNIN_SERVICES_ID
vars.description: Apple Services ID (the web client id, e.g. com.example.app.signin) for the 'apple' sign-in method. Injected from the account's Apple Sign-In integration; empty when not connected.

vars.name: APPLE_SIGNIN_TEAM_ID
vars.description: Apple developer Team ID (10 characters); the issuer of the client-secret JWT minted for Apple's token endpoint.

vars.name: APPLE_SIGNIN_KEY_ID
vars.description: Key ID of the 'Sign in with Apple' private key (10 characters).

vars.name: APPLE_SIGNIN_PRIVATE_KEY
vars.description: The 'Sign in with Apple' private key: the downloaded AuthKey_<keyId>.p8 contents, as raw PEM or base64-encoded PEM (the platform stages base64 so the multiline key survives the env file).

vars.name: APPLE_SIGNIN_BUNDLE_ID
vars.description: Native app bundle id accepted as the audience of native Sign in with Apple identity tokens (POST /apple/native). Falls back to the Services ID when empty.

vars.name: GITHUB_SIGNIN_CLIENT_ID
vars.description: GitHub OAuth app client id for the 'github' sign-in method. Injected from the account's GitHub Sign-In integration; empty when not connected.

vars.name: GITHUB_SIGNIN_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.description: GitHub OAuth app client secret for the server-side code exchange.

vars.name: FACEBOOK_SIGNIN_CLIENT_ID
vars.description: Facebook app id for the 'facebook' sign-in method. Injected from the account's Facebook Sign-In integration; empty when not connected.

vars.name: FACEBOOK_SIGNIN_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.description: Facebook app secret for the server-side code exchange.

vars.name: DISCORD_SIGNIN_CLIENT_ID
vars.description: Discord application client id for the 'discord' sign-in method. Injected from the account's Discord Sign-In integration; empty when not connected.

vars.name: DISCORD_SIGNIN_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.description: Discord application client secret for the server-side code exchange.

vars.name: X_SIGNIN_CLIENT_ID
vars.description: X (Twitter) OAuth2 client id for the 'x' sign-in method. The X app must have 'Request email from users' enabled so sign-in can read the confirmed email. Injected from the account's X Sign-In integration; empty when not connected.

vars.name: X_SIGNIN_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.description: X (Twitter) OAuth2 client secret for the server-side code exchange (Basic auth at the token endpoint).

vars.name: LINKEDIN_SIGNIN_CLIENT_ID
vars.description: LinkedIn OIDC client id for the 'linkedin' sign-in method. Injected from the account's LinkedIn Sign-In integration; empty when not connected.

vars.name: LINKEDIN_SIGNIN_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.description: LinkedIn OIDC client secret for the server-side code exchange.

vars.name: TOPIC_PREFIX
vars.description: Namespace prefix for every Pub/Sub topic (deployed environments share a GCP project). Injected by the platform; empty locally.

vars.name: DEPLOY_POSTURE
vars.description: 'dev' or 'prod', injected by the platform. Dev-posture deploys may run the simulated (local) payments mode when no Stripe integration is connected yet; prod never may. AI never needs this fallback: keyless deploys run the real model through the platform AI gateway on every posture. Empty locally (the emulator check covers it).

vars.name: PAYMENTS_MODE
vars.description: 'local' (in-app simulated test checkout: emulator, tests, and dev-posture deploys without a connected Stripe account) or 'stripe' (real Stripe Checkout Sessions). Production boot refuses 'local'.

vars.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
vars.description: Stripe API secret key for creating and verifying Checkout Sessions. Injected by the platform from the account's connected Stripe integration when the deploy manifest declares the PAYMENTS capability; never present locally.

vars.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
vars.description: Signing secret ('whsec_...') for the payments webhook endpoint (payments__request__api POST /webhook). Optional: without it the endpoint refuses deliveries, and payment state still converges through server-side verification on the success page.

vars.name: AI_MODE
vars.description: 'local' (simulated assistant: emulator and tests), 'openai' (real OpenAI models on the account's own key), or 'gateway' (real models through the platform's AI gateway, keyless, billed to the account's platform credits). Production boot refuses 'local'; the platform picks 'openai' vs 'gateway' per deploy based on whether an OpenAI integration is connected.

vars.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
vars.description: OpenAI API secret key for the chat model and realtime voice sessions. Injected by the platform from the account's connected OpenAI integration when the deploy manifest declares the AI capability; never present locally (the sandbox runs AI_MODE=local). Empty on keyless deploys (AI_MODE=gateway).

vars.name: AI_GATEWAY_URL
vars.description: Base URL of the platform's AI gateway function (POST /responses, POST /embeddings, POST /realtime/sessions). Injected by the platform on keyless AI deploys (AI_MODE=gateway); empty when the account brings its own OpenAI key and never present locally.

vars.name: AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN
vars.description: Per-environment bearer token for the platform's AI gateway, minted by the platform's AI_GATEWAY provisioning step. Injected on keyless AI deploys (AI_MODE=gateway); empty when the account brings its own OpenAI key and never present locally. Also used for ElevenLabs STT/TTS when ELEVENLABS_MODE=gateway.

vars.name: ELEVENLABS_MODE
vars.description: 'local' (sandbox: voice turns accept a transcript and skip ElevenLabs), 'elevenlabs' (real STT/TTS on the account's own key), or 'gateway' (real STT/TTS through the platform's AI gateway, keyless, billed to the account's platform credits). Production boot refuses 'local'; the platform picks 'elevenlabs' vs 'gateway' per deploy based on whether an ElevenLabs integration is connected.

vars.name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
vars.description: ElevenLabs API secret key for speech-to-text and text-to-speech. Injected by the platform from the account's connected ElevenLabs integration when the deploy manifest declares the AI capability; never present locally (the sandbox runs ELEVENLABS_MODE=local). Empty on keyless deploys (ELEVENLABS_MODE=gateway).

vars.name: ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID
vars.description: Optional ElevenLabs voice id. Empty uses the kernel default (see ElevenLabsService). Override to restyle the spoken voice without a code change.

vars.name: QUICKBOOKS_MODE
vars.description: 'local' (deterministic simulated QuickBooks sample company; the default everywhere) or 'intuit' (the real QuickBooks Online API behind the same interface: Intuit OAuth connect plus live reads; staged by the platform when the account binds an Intuit integration).

vars.name: QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID
vars.description: The Intuit app's OAuth 2.0 client id. Injected by the platform from the account's connected Intuit integration alongside QUICKBOOKS_MODE=intuit; never present locally.

vars.name: QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.description: The Intuit app's OAuth 2.0 client secret, used for the OAuth code exchange and token refresh. Injected by the platform from the account's connected Intuit integration; never present locally.

vars.name: QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT
vars.description: 'sandbox' or 'production': which Intuit environment the app's keys belong to; picks the QuickBooks Online API host. Ignored in QUICKBOOKS_MODE=local.

vars.name: DOCUMENTS_MODE
vars.description: 'local' (renders PDFs with the machine's own Chromium; emulator/tests only) or 'platform' (the platform-hosted render service). Deployed boot refuses 'local'.

vars.name: DOCUMENTS_RENDER_URL
vars.description: Base URL of the platform's shared document render service. Injected by the platform when the deploy manifest declares the DOCUMENTS capability; never present locally (the sandbox runs DOCUMENTS_MODE=local).

vars.name: DOCUMENTS_TOKEN
vars.description: Bearer token for the platform's document render service, scoped to this deploy. Minted by the platform when the deploy manifest declares the DOCUMENTS capability.

vars.name: DOCUMENTS_CHROMIUM_PATH
vars.description: Optional path to a Chromium/Chrome executable for local PDF rendering (DOCUMENTS_MODE=local). Well-known install locations are probed when unset.

vars.name: STORAGE_MODE
vars.description: 'local' (file bytes on disk under STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR, served by the storage function: emulator, tests, and dev-posture deploys without provisioned storage) or 'gcs' (a provisioned Cloud Storage bucket via V4 signed URLs). Production boot refuses 'local'.

vars.name: STORAGE_BUCKET
vars.description: Name of the provisioned Cloud Storage bucket for the uploads kernel (STORAGE_MODE=gcs). Injected by the platform when the deploy manifest declares the STORAGE capability; never present locally (the sandbox runs STORAGE_MODE=local).

vars.name: STORAGE_PREFIX
vars.description: Object key prefix inside STORAGE_BUCKET (environments share a per-posture bucket; the platform injects the environment's slug so keys never collide). Empty = bucket root.

vars.name: STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR
vars.description: Optional override for the local-mode storage data directory (STORAGE_MODE=local). Defaults to .devdata/storage at the repo root.

vars.name: JOBS_MODE
vars.description: 'local' (an in-process 60s ticker runs due jobs: emulator, tests, and dev-posture deploys without a provisioned scheduler) or 'scheduler' (the platform's Cloud Scheduler POSTs /tick on jobs__request__api). Production boot refuses 'local'.

vars.name: JOBS_TOKEN
vars.description: Bearer token guarding POST /tick on jobs__request__api. Minted per environment by the platform's JOBS_SCHEDULER provisioning step when the deploy manifest declares the JOBS capability; never present locally (the sandbox runs JOBS_MODE=local).

vars.name: PUSH_MODE
vars.description: 'local' (no real delivery: the emulator/tests record pushes with the in-memory fake, and a deploy in this mode treats push as not configured) or 'live' (Web Push over the platform-minted VAPID keypair). Unconfigured sends degrade to a log line (docs/push.md) — never a boot failure.

vars.name: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
vars.description: VAPID public key (base64url, P-256) for Web Push, minted per project by the platform's PUSH_CREDENTIALS step. Empty = the WEB channel is not configured and pushes degrade to log lines. Optional locally: paste a `npx web-push generate-vapid-keys` pair (with VITE_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY) to exercise the browser flow end-to-end.

vars.name: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
vars.description: VAPID private key matching VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY. Minted and held by the platform; empty = the WEB channel is not configured.

vars.name: APNS_TEAM_ID
vars.description: Apple Developer team id for APNs token-based auth, staged by the platform when the customer connects their Apple push key. Empty = the IOS channel is not configured and native pushes degrade to log lines (docs/push.md).

vars.name: APNS_KEY_ID
vars.description: Key id of the customer's APNs auth key (.p8). Empty = the IOS channel is not configured.

vars.name: APNS_PRIVATE_KEY
vars.description: The APNs auth key (.p8) contents, base64-encoded. Held by the platform; empty = the IOS channel is not configured.

vars.name: APNS_BUNDLE_ID
vars.description: The iOS app's bundle id (the apns-topic header). Empty = the IOS channel is not configured.

vars.name: APNS_ENVIRONMENT
vars.description: 'production' targets api.push.apple.com (App Store / TestFlight builds); 'sandbox' targets Apple's sandbox gateway for development-signed builds.

vars.name: FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
vars.description: Firebase service-account JSON (base64) for FCM HTTP v1, staged by the platform when the customer connects their Firebase project. Empty = the ANDROID channel is not configured and native pushes degrade to log lines.

vars.name: VITE_GRAPHQL_URL
vars.description: GraphQL endpoint the web app talks to.

vars.name: VITE_AUTH_MODE
vars.description: Mirrors AUTH_MODE for the web client. In builtin mode the client derives the auth endpoint from VITE_GRAPHQL_URL.

vars.name: VITE_DEMO_MODE
vars.description: "true" = demo mode: GraphQL and AI chat resolve against in-memory fixtures so a static build runs with no backend. Used by marketing-site preview builds; never set in deployed apps.

vars.name: VITE_APP_NAME
vars.description: Display name shown on the login page brand row. Falls back to 'My App' when unset.

vars.name: VITE_AUTH_METHODS
vars.description: Comma-separated sign-in methods rendered by the login surface, in order: email-code, password, google, apple, anonymous. Defaults to email-code. google requires the account's Google Sign-In integration; apple requires the Apple Sign-In integration.

vars.name: VITE_AUTH_GOOGLE_ENABLED
vars.description: Legacy alias: 'true' appends google to VITE_AUTH_METHODS. Prefer listing google in VITE_AUTH_METHODS directly. Off by default: environments without the Google Sign-In integration have no OAuth provider configured.

vars.name: VITE_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
vars.description: Mirrors VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY for the web client: the applicationServerKey the Settings 'Notifications' preference subscribes with. Empty = the preference shows push as unavailable in this environment.

vars.name: VITE_LOCAL_AUTH_TOKEN
vars.description: Signed dev-principal JWT generated by bootstrap:env. Local mode only.
